snippet.title: BEYBLADE: Metal Fusion - Battle Fortress (Wii) Debut Trailer
snippet.description:
This is the trailer for the new Beyblade Metal Fusion game on the Wii, "Battle Fortress", the English equivalent of Gachinko Stadium. Both are released by Hudson. 

It will come out some time in fall 2010, for the holiday season. 


For more information, visit : 
http://www.cybertigeranime.com/bbspirit/
http://worldbeyblade.org/
